column2: Drop the dried yarrow into finished wheat ale to spice it.
column3: 把干蓍草放进发酵完成的小麦麦酒里，为它调味。

column2: Drop the dried ginger into finished billberry wine to spice it.
column3: 把干姜放进发酵完成的越橘酒里，为它调味。

column2: Drop the dried ginger into finished birch wine to spice it.
column3: 把干姜放进发酵完成的桦树酒里，为它调味。

column2: Drop the dried ginger into finished springberry wine to spice it.
column3: 把干姜放进发酵完成的春莓酒里，为它调味。

column2: Drop the dried ginger into finished rye ale to spice it.
column3: 把干姜放进发酵完成的黑麦麦酒里，为它调味。

column2: Drop the dried ginger into finished wheat ale to spice it.
column3: 把干姜放进发酵完成的小麦麦酒里，为它调味。

column2: A golden, funnel-shaped mushroom that might be a Chanterelle, or might be its look-alike, the False Chanterelle. Identify it before you eat it.
column3: 一朵金黄色的漏斗形蘑菇，可能是鸡油菌，也可能是与它相似的假鸡油菌。吃之前先辨认清楚。

column2: Found by: foraging wherever Chanterelles grow; about one find in four is an Unknown Chanterelle. Uses: Identify it to learn what it is: with Herbalism skill 25 or more, by dragging a Botanical Field Guide onto it (the guide is not used up), or, with Community Mod Chest installed, once you have graduated the Academy's Herbalism course. It turns into a Chanterelle or a False Chanterelle. Eating it unidentified gives food poisoning.
column3: 获取方式：在生长鸡油菌的地方觅食；大约四次中有一次找到的是未知鸡油菌。 用途：辨认它以弄清是什么：草药学技能达到25或以上即可辨认；或把植物图鉴拖到它上面（图鉴不会被用掉）；或在安装了社区模组箱并从学院草药学课程毕业后辨认。它会变成鸡油菌或假鸡油菌。未经辨认就吃会导致食物中毒。
这朵不明蘑菇已经腐坏了。

column2: Look closely at the gills, the cap and the smell. Needs Herbalism skill 25 or more.
column3: 仔细查看菌褶、菌盖并闻一闻气味。需要草药学技能达到25或以上。

column2: Your Academy herbalism course taught you how to tell a Chanterelle from its look-alike.
column3: 你在学院的草药学课程中学会了如何分辨鸡油菌和与它相似的蘑菇。

column2: Eat it without knowing what it is. It fills you a little, but it gives you food poisoning.
column3: 不知道它是什么就吃下去。能稍微填饱肚子，但会让你食物中毒。

column2: Compare it with the drawings in the Botanical Field Guide. The guide is not used up.
column3: 把它和植物图鉴里的插图对照。图鉴不会被用掉。

column2: An orange look-alike of the Chanterelle, with true gills instead of soft ridges. Not good to eat: it gives food poisoning.
column3: 一种外形酷似鸡油菌的橙色蘑菇，长着真正的菌褶而不是柔软的棱脊。不宜食用：吃了会食物中毒。

column2: Found by: identifying an Unknown Chanterelle; about one in four turns out to be this look-alike. Uses: none. It is not food: eating it gives food poisoning. Leave it to rot or throw it away.
column3: 获取方式：辨认未知鸡油菌；大约四朵中有一朵会是这种相似的蘑菇。 用途：无。它不是食物：吃了会食物中毒。任它腐烂或者扔掉。
这朵假鸡油菌已经烂掉了。

column2: It is barely food, and it gives you food poisoning.
column3: 它几乎算不上食物，还会让你食物中毒。

column2: Hidden flag: 1 while the player holds Community Mod Chest's Herbalism graduate perk, else 0. Mirrored every few seconds by AcademyHerbalismBridgePatch; it gates the Identify (Academy training) action on the Unknown Chanterelle. Always 0 without Community Mod Chest.
column3: 隐藏标记：玩家持有社区模组箱的草药学毕业特质时为1，否则为0。每隔几秒同步一次；用于开启未知鸡油菌上的辨认（学院所学）动作。未安装社区模组箱时始终为0。

column2: A small hemp-paper notebook. Once you carry it, it writes down each wild plant and mushroom you find and the place where you first found it.
column3: 一本用大麻纸做的小笔记本。带在身上时，它会记下你发现的每一种野生植物和蘑菇，以及你第一次发现它的地点。

column2: Made from: three sheets of Hemp Paper and twine, from the Support tab. Uses: Keep it in your inventory. Each time a wild plant or mushroom of this mod turns up in your hands, the notebook adds it under the place where you got it, the first time only. Open the card to read the list. Foraged finds are what it is for, but anything of that kind you receive is written down too. The list is saved with the notebook. Placeholder art.
column3: 制作材料：三张大麻纸和麻线，在支持分类中制作。 用途：放在背包里即可。每当本模组的野生植物或蘑菇到了你手里，笔记本就会把它记在你获得它的地点之下，只记第一次。打开卡牌即可查看清单。它主要用来记录采集所得，但其他途径得到的同类物品也会被记下。清单随笔记本一起存档。占位图片。

column2: Bind a few sheets of hemp paper with twine into a notebook that records what you find and where.
column3: 用麻线把几张大麻纸装订成一本笔记本，记录你发现了什么、在哪里发现的。

column2: A death cap dried hard and light, still deadly. Folk herbalists claim that a sliver no bigger than a grain of rice, taken with great care, teaches the body to withstand the next poisoning. It is never safe.
column3: 一朵晒得又硬又轻的毒鹅膏，毒性丝毫未减。民间草药师相传，只取米粒大小的一小片，小心翼翼地尝一口，身体就能慢慢抵御下一次中毒。但这绝不安全。

column2: Use: Taste a Sliver gives a short bout of mild food poisoning (+4, below the Death Cap Tincture's +15) and builds Toxin Tolerance, which makes later food poisoning fade faster while it lasts. Each sliver uses up the dried cap. Warning: Do not eat a death cap whole. The dose and the length of the tolerance are starting values, not tuned.
column3: 用途：尝一小片会引起一阵轻微的食物中毒（+4，低于毒鹅膏酊剂的 +15），并积累毒素耐受，耐受持续期间，之后的食物中毒会消退得更快。每尝一片就会用掉一朵干毒鹅膏。 警告：千万不要整朵吃下毒鹅膏。剂量和耐受持续时间只是初始数值，尚未调校。

column2: The Dried Death Cap crumbled to a harmless-looking dust.
column3: 干毒鹅膏碎成了看似无害的粉末。

column2: Shave off a sliver and taste it. A mild bout of food poisoning now, and a body that shrugs off the next one for a while. Uses up the dried cap.
column3: 削下一小片尝一尝。眼下会有一阵轻微的食物中毒，但身体在一段时间内能扛住下一次中毒。会用掉这朵干毒鹅膏。

column2: Small, careful tastes of a mild poison have taught your body to shrug off the next one. A bout of food poisoning clears faster while this lasts, and it wears off over the next two days.
column3: 一次次小心谨慎地尝下少量轻毒，让你的身体学会了扛住下一次中毒。耐受持续期间，食物中毒会消退得更快，并会在接下来的两天里逐渐消失。

column2: Your body is learning to shrug off a mild poison. Food poisoning fades faster for now.
column3: 你的身体正在学着扛住轻微的毒素。眼下食物中毒会消退得更快。

column2: Several slivers taken close together. Food poisoning fades much faster until the tolerance wears down.
column3: 短时间内连尝了好几片。在耐受消退之前，食物中毒会消退得快得多。

column2: A hardy dark leafy green that stands the cold. Eat the leaves raw, or stir them into a stew.
column3: 一种耐寒的深色叶菜。可以生吃，也可以放进炖菜里。

column2: The kale has wilted and rotted.
column3: 羽衣甘蓝已经枯萎腐烂。

column2: Eat the kale. Tough and slightly bitter, but filling.
column3: 吃羽衣甘蓝。叶子偏硬，略带苦味，但很顶饱。

column2: Plant 2 kale in fertile ground to grow a patch of kale. Hardy, and it gives back more than you planted.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上种下2份羽衣甘蓝，长出一片羽衣甘蓝。很耐寒，收获的比种下的多。

column2: A young patch of kale with curled dark leaves. Leave it to grow before cutting.
column3: 一片长着卷曲深色叶子的幼嫩羽衣甘蓝。等它长大后再割。

column2: Growth Time: 15 days. Produces: 2 to 3 Kale when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长时间：15天。 产出：长成后2到3份羽衣甘蓝。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。

column2: A patch of full-grown kale. Cut it for fresh kale.
column3: 一片完全长成的羽衣甘蓝。割下它获取新鲜羽衣甘蓝。

column2: Harvest: 2 to 3 Kale. The plant is used up.
column3: 采收：2到3份羽衣甘蓝。植株会被用尽。

column2: A sweet orange root that keeps well in a cool place. Eat it raw, or stir it into a stew.
column3: 一种甜甜的橙色根菜，放在阴凉处能存放很久。可以生吃，也可以放进炖菜里。

column2: The carrot has gone soft and rotted.
Eat the carrot. Crunchy and sweet.
Plant 2 carrots in fertile ground to grow a row of carrots. Slow to grow, and it gives back more than you planted.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上种下2根胡萝卜，长出一垄胡萝卜。生长缓慢，收获的比种下的多。

column2: A row of young carrots, only their feathery tops showing. Leave them to swell before pulling.
column3: 一垄幼嫩的胡萝卜，只露出羽状的顶叶。等它们长粗后再拔。

column2: Growth Time: 24 days. Produces: 2 to 3 Carrot when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长时间：24天。 产出：长成后2到3份胡萝卜。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。

column2: A row of full-grown carrots. Pull them for fresh carrots.
column3: 一垄完全长成的胡萝卜。拔出它们获取新鲜胡萝卜。

column2: Harvest: 2 to 3 Carrot. The plant is used up.
column3: 采收：2到3份胡萝卜。植株会被用尽。

column2: A mild, long white stem of the onion family. Eat it raw, or stir it into a stew for flavour.
column3: 洋葱家族中口味温和的白色长茎。可以生吃，也可以放进炖菜里增添风味。

column2: The leek has gone slimy and rotted.
Eat the leek. Mild and a little sharp.
column3: 吃韭葱。味道温和，略带辛辣。

column2: Plant 2 leeks in fertile ground to grow a bed of leeks. Very slow to grow, but a good yield.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上种下2根韭葱，长出一畦韭葱。生长很慢，但产量不错。

column2: A bed of young leeks, thin as grass. Leave them to thicken before pulling.
column3: 一畦细如青草的幼嫩韭葱。等它们长粗后再拔。

column2: Growth Time: 30 days. Produces: 2 to 3 Leek when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长时间：30天。 产出：长成后2到3份韭葱。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。

column2: A bed of full-grown leeks. Pull them for fresh leeks.
column3: 一畦完全长成的韭葱。拔出它们获取新鲜韭葱。

column2: Harvest: 2 to 3 Leek. The plant is used up.
column3: 采收：2到3份韭葱。植株会被用尽。

column2: Stir ginseng powder into Reishi Tea in a medicine cauldron to brew a strong Vigor Elixir.
column3: 在药用大锅中将人参粉搅入灵芝茶，酿成药效强劲的活力灵药。

column2: A strong, bitter elixir of reishi tea fortified with ground ginseng, brewed in the medicine cauldron. Holds the immune system strong for far longer than a tea.
column3: 在药用大锅中以人参粉强化灵芝茶酿成的苦味浓药。能让免疫力保持强健，远比普通药茶持久。

column2: Preparation: At a medicine station (Clay Cauldron or Copper Cauldron), stir ground ginseng into a pot of Reishi Tea. Benefits: A strong dose of Herbal Tonic (placeholder 72 of 96), well above any tea, plus the usual refreshment.
column3: 制作：在药用工作台（陶土大锅或铜大锅）中，将人参粉搅入一锅灵芝茶。 功效：提供强效草药补剂（暂定 72/96），远超任何药茶，并带来常规的提神效果。

column2: The fish mash has gone off.
Stir the fish mash into water and leave it to ferment into fish sauce. The mash is used up.
column3: 将鱼糜搅入水中静置发酵成鱼露。鱼糜会被用尽。

column2: Raw fish pounded with salt into a pungent paste. Stir it into a pot of water and leave it to ferment into fish sauce.
column3: 生鱼加盐捣成的辛辣鱼糜。搅入一锅水中静置发酵，即成鱼露。

column2: Made from: Two raw fish (lean or fatty) and one Salt, from the Cooking tab. Uses: Drag it onto a pot or bowl of water (at least a third of a pot) and the water becomes Young Fish Sauce; the mash is used up. Not food on its own.
column3: 制作：两份生鱼（瘦鱼或肥鱼）加一份盐，在烹饪标签页制作。 用途：将其拖到一锅或一碗水上，水会变成新鱼露，鱼糜被用尽。不可直接食用。

column2: Fish mash steeping in water. Leave it in any container for about five days and it ferments into fish sauce. Not ready to use.
column3: 浸在水中的鱼糜。放在任何容器里静置约五天，就会发酵成鱼露。尚不能使用。

column2: Made from: Drag Salted Fish Mash onto water. Next: After about five days (a tunable placeholder) it turns into Fish Sauce.
column3: 制作：将咸鱼糜拖到水上。 之后：约五天后（暂定时长）变成鱼露。

column2: The young fish sauce has gone off.
Splash fish sauce onto a plated food to season it.
column3: 把鱼露洒在装盘的食物上调味。

column2: Sip the salty, pungent sauce. Nourishes a little and leaves you thirstier.
column3: 抿一口咸辣的鱼露。略有营养，但会更口渴。

column2: A salty, pungent sauce fermented from fish and salt. Splash it onto a plated food to season it, or sip it.
column3: 用鱼和盐发酵而成的咸辣酱汁。洒在装盘的食物上调味，也可以直接抿一口。

column2: Made from: Drag Salted Fish Mash onto water, then leave the Young Fish Sauce for about five days. Uses: Drag it onto a plateable food to season it (adds savoury and salty, a little pungent; each splash uses a little of the sauce). Drink it for a small amount of nourishment. Keeps: Spoils at half the rate of an ordinary liquid.
column3: 制作：将咸鱼糜拖到水上，再把新鱼露放置约五天。 用途：拖到可装盘的食物上调味（增添鲜味和咸味，略带辛辣；每次洒用少量酱汁）。也可饮用，获得少量营养。 保存：变质速度为普通液体的一半。

column2: The fish sauce has gone off.
Dried fish steeping in lye. Leave it alone while the Soaking bar fills, about two days, and it becomes Lye-Cured Fish. Caustic; do not eat.
column3: 正在碱液中浸泡的鱼干。放着不动，等“浸泡”进度条走满（约两天），就会变成碱化鱼。有腐蚀性，不可食用。

column2: Made from: One Dried Fish (lean or fatty) and a bowl of Lye, from the Cooking tab. The lye is used up. Next: It turns into Lye-Cured Fish after about two days (a tunable placeholder).
column3: 制作：一份鱼干（瘦鱼或肥鱼）和一碗碱液，在烹饪标签页制作。碱液会被用掉。 之后：约两天后（暂定时长）变成碱化鱼。

column2: The lye-soaked fish has gone off.
The fish has soaked in the lye.
Fish gone soft and translucent in lye. Still caustic: rinse it in water before cooking.
column3: 在碱液中变得柔软半透明的鱼。仍有腐蚀性，烹饪前要用水冲洗。

column2: Made from: Leave Lye-Soaked Fish for about two days. Next: Drag it onto a pot or bowl of water to rinse it into Rinsed Lye Fish. A rinse uses up some of the water. Do not eat it unrinsed.
column3: 制作：将浸碱鱼放置约两天。 之后：将其拖到一锅或一碗水上冲洗，得到冲洗过的碱鱼。冲洗会用掉一些水。未冲洗不可食用。

column2: The lye-cured fish has gone off.
Rinse the lye out of the fish. Uses up some of the water.
column3: 把鱼上的碱液冲洗干净。会用掉一些水。

column2: Lye-cured fish, rinsed clean. Cook it over a fire to finish the lutefisk.
column3: 冲洗干净的碱化鱼。放在火上烹熟，即成碱鱼。

column2: Made from: Rinse Lye-Cured Fish in water. Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Lutefisk.
column3: 制作：用水冲洗碱化鱼。 之后：放在火边加热，待“烹饪”进度条走满，就变成碱鱼。

column2: The rinsed lye fish has gone off.
Dried fish cured in lye, rinsed and cooked until it flakes: soft, gelatinous and mild. A hearty northern dish.
column3: 鱼干经碱液处理、冲洗、烹熟后松软，口感如胶质，味道温和。一道扎实的北方菜肴。

column2: Made from: Dried fish soaked in lye (about two days), rinsed in water, then cooked over a fire. Uses: Eat it for a filling fish meal (values are tunable placeholders). Counts as a fish meal for fish boredom.
column3: 制作：鱼干在碱液中浸泡（约两天），用水冲洗，再放在火上烹熟。 用途：食用后能饱腹（数值为暂定）。计入鱼类厌倦度。

column2: Pound two raw lean fish with a measure of salt into a paste that will ferment into fish sauce.
column3: 将两份生瘦鱼与适量盐捣成鱼糜，可发酵成鱼露。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Raw Lean Fish Meat
Steep dried lean fish in a bowl of lye to begin lutefisk. The lye is used up.
column3: 将瘦鱼鱼干泡在一碗碱液中，开始制作碱鱼。碱液会被用掉。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Dried Lean Fish Meat
Pound two raw fatty fish with a measure of salt into a paste that will ferment into fish sauce.
column3: 将两份生肥鱼与适量盐捣成鱼糜，可发酵成鱼露。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Raw Fatty Fish Meat
Steep dried fatty fish in a bowl of lye to begin lutefisk. The lye is used up.
column3: 将肥鱼鱼干泡在一碗碱液中，开始制作碱鱼。碱液会被用掉。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Dried Fatty Fish Meat
A bowl of thick, savoury soup simmered from tendon until it turns soft and gelatinous, with dried yarrow for a bitter edge.
column3: 用肌腱慢炖至软糯胶质的浓稠鲜汤，加入干蓍草，带一丝苦味。

column2: Made by: Blueprint: Tendon Soup (2 Tendon, a Clay Bowl and Dried Yarrow). Uses: Drink for hydration and a solid meal (values are tunable placeholders). Benefits: Hydrating and filling, mildly calming. Savoury and bitter.
column3: 制作：蓝图：肌腱汤（2份肌腱、1只黏土碗和干蓍草）。 用途：饮用可补水并果腹（数值为可调整的占位值）。 功效：补水、饱腹，略能安神。味道鲜美微苦。

column2: Simmer tendon with a pinch of dried yarrow in a clay bowl until it softens into a thick, savoury soup.
column3: 把肌腱和一撮干蓍草放进黏土碗里炖煮，直到化作浓稠鲜美的汤。

column2: A patty of minced fish bound with flour and a pinch of dried dandelion. Cook it near a fire.
column3: 用鱼肉末、面粉和一撮干蒲公英捏成的饼坯。需在火旁烹熟。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Fishcake (Fish Filling, flour and Dried Dandelion). Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes a Fishcake.
column3: 制作：蓝图：鱼饼（生鱼馅、面粉和干蒲公英）。 下一步：放在火旁加热，烹饪条满后变成鱼饼。

column2: The raw fishcake has gone off.
A golden patty of minced fish and flour, lightly bitter with dandelion. Plain, filling fare.
column3: 金黄的鱼肉面饼，带着蒲公英的微苦。朴素而扎实的食物。

column2: Made from: A Raw Fishcake cooked over a fire. Uses: Eat it for a filling fish meal (values are tunable placeholders). Counts as a fish meal for fish boredom.
column3: 制作：将生鱼饼在火上烹熟。 用途：食用可当一顿扎实的鱼肉餐（数值为可调整的占位值）。计入鱼类厌倦度。

column2: Work rye flour and dried dandelion into raw fish filling to shape a patty that can be cooked into a fishcake.
column3: 把黑麦面粉和干蒲公英揉进生鱼馅，捏成可烹成鱼饼的饼坯。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Raw Fish Filling
Work wheat flour and dried dandelion into raw fish filling to shape a patty that can be cooked into a fishcake.
column3: 把小麦面粉和干蒲公英揉进生鱼馅，捏成可烹成鱼饼的饼坯。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Raw Fish Filling
A cleaned stomach stuffed with liver, heart, rye grain and dried plantain. Cook it near a fire.
column3: 洗净的胃里塞满肝、心、黑麦粒和干车前草。需在火旁烹熟。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Haggis (a Clean Stomach, Liver, Heart, Rye Grains and Dried Common Plantain). Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Haggis (no separate boil step in this version).
column3: 制作：蓝图：肚包杂碎（干净的胃、肝脏、心脏、黑麦粒和干车前草）。 下一步：放在火旁加热，烹饪条满后变成肚包杂碎（此版本没有单独的水煮步骤）。

column2: The raw haggis has gone off.
Offal and rye grain packed into a stomach and cooked until firm: rich, herbal and very filling.
column3: 内脏和黑麦粒塞进胃里煮至紧实：味道浓郁，带着草药香，十分顶饱。

column2: Made from: A Raw Haggis cooked over a fire. Uses: Eat it for a heavy meat meal (values are tunable placeholders). Counts as a meat meal for meat boredom.
column3: 制作：将生肚包杂碎在火上烹熟。 用途：食用可当一顿分量十足的肉餐（数值为可调整的占位值）。计入肉类厌倦度。

column2: Stuff a cleaned stomach with liver, heart, rye grain and dried plantain to make a raw haggis.
column3: 往洗净的胃里塞入肝、心、黑麦粒和干车前草，做成生肚包杂碎。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining a Cleaned Stomach
Rye dough worked with ground malted rye. Bake it near a fire.
column3: 黑麦面团拌入磨碎的黑麦麦芽粉揉成。需在火旁烤熟。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Sprouted Rye Bread (Rye Grist and Rye Dough). Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Sprouted Rye Bread.
column3: 制作：蓝图：发芽黑麦面包（黑麦麦芽粗粉和黑麦面团）。 下一步：在火旁加热，直到烹饪条满，即成发芽黑麦面包。

column2: The raw sprouted rye bread has gone off.
column3: 生发芽黑麦面包变质了。

column2: The sprouted rye bread is baked.
A dense, faintly sweet bread made with ground malted rye. Plain and filling.
column3: 用磨碎的黑麦麦芽粉做成的紧实面包，带一丝甜味。朴素而扎实。

column2: Made from: Raw Sprouted Rye Bread baked near a fire. Uses: Eat it for a filling meal (values are tunable placeholders, copied from the vanilla rye flatbread).
column3: 制作：生发芽黑麦面包在火旁烤熟。 用途：吃下它可饱腹（数值为可调占位值，取自原版黑麦薄饼）。

column2: The sprouted rye bread has gone off.
Dough kneaded with dried nettle leaves. Bake it near a fire.
column3: 黑麦或小麦面团揉入干荨麻叶。需在火旁烤熟。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Nettle Bread (rye or wheat dough and Dried Nettle Leaves). Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Nettle Bread.
column3: 制作：蓝图：荨麻面包（黑麦或小麦面团和干荨麻叶）。 下一步：在火旁加热，直到烹饪条满，即成荨麻面包。

column2: The raw nettle bread has gone off.
A green-flecked loaf with a grassy, peppery bite. Plain and filling.
column3: 带绿色碎叶的面包，有青草般的微辛。朴素而扎实。

column2: Made from: Raw Nettle Bread baked near a fire. Uses: Eat it for a filling meal (values are tunable placeholders, copied from the vanilla rye flatbread).
column3: 制作：生荨麻面包在火旁烤熟。 用途：吃下它可饱腹（数值为可调占位值，取自原版黑麦薄饼）。

column2: The nettle bread has gone off.
Work ground malted rye into rye dough to shape a loaf that can be baked into sprouted rye bread.
column3: 把磨碎的黑麦麦芽粉揉进黑麦面团，捏成可烤成发芽黑麦面包的面坯。
获得黑麦麦芽粗粉后解锁

column2: Knead dried nettle leaves into rye dough to shape a loaf that can be baked into nettle bread.
column3: 把干荨麻叶揉进黑麦面团，捏成可烤成荨麻面包的面坯。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Dried Nettle Leaves
Knead dried nettle leaves into wheat dough to shape a loaf that can be baked into nettle bread.
column3: 把干荨麻叶揉进小麦面团，捏成可烤成荨麻面包的面坯。

column2: Unlocked after obtaining Dried Nettle Leaves
Papery green hop cones from a climbing vine, bitter and resinous. Drag them onto a bowl of finished rye ale to make hopped ale.
column3: 攀缘藤蔓上纸质般的绿色啤酒花球果，带着苦味和树脂味。把它拖到一碗发酵完成的黑麦酒上，就能做成啤酒花麦酒。

column2: Found: Foraging in summer and autumn at the Alder Grove and the Mossy Clearing. Uses: Drag onto finished rye ale in a bowl to make Hopped Ale (fresh wort will not take them). Holding them unlocks Plant Hops.
column3: 来源：夏季和秋季在桤木林地和覆苔林隙采集获得。 用途：拖到碗里发酵完成的黑麦酒上，做成啤酒花麦酒（新鲜麦汁不接受）。持有它可解锁“种植啤酒花”。

column2: Steep the hops in finished rye ale to make hopped ale.
column3: 把啤酒花浸入发酵完成的黑麦酒，做成啤酒花麦酒。

column2: Plant 2 hop cones in fertile ground to grow a hop vine.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上种下2份啤酒花，长出一株啤酒花藤。

column2: A young hop vine winding up its pole. Leave it to climb and flower before picking.
column3: 一株正沿着支杆攀爬的幼嫩啤酒花藤。等它爬高开花后再采摘。

column2: Growth Time: 30 days. Produces: 2 to 4 Hops when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长时间：30天。 产出：成熟时产出2到4份啤酒花。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。

column2: A tall hop vine hung with cones. Pick it for fresh hops.
column3: 一株挂满球果的高大啤酒花藤。采摘它获取新鲜啤酒花。

column2: Harvest: 2 to 4 Hops. The plant is used up.
column3: 采收：2到4份啤酒花。植株会被用尽。

column2: Pick the hop cones from the vine.
column3: 从藤上采下啤酒花球果。

column2:
Rye ale steeped with hop cones. Bitter, a little flowery and slow to spoil.

Drink in moderation!
column3:
浸泡过啤酒花的黑麦酒。微苦，略带花香，不易变质。

请适量饮用！

column2: Made from: Drag Hops onto a bowl of finished rye ale. Fresh wort will not take them: let the wort ferment first. The hops are used up. Keeps: It spoils half as fast as plain rye ale. It does not freeze and does not age further in a barrel.
column3: 制作：把啤酒花拖到一碗发酵完成的黑麦酒上。新鲜麦汁不接受：先让麦汁发酵。啤酒花会被用掉。 保存：变质速度只有普通黑麦酒的一半。不会结冰，也不会在桶中继续陈化。

column2: The hopped ale has gone off.
A bunch of small dark grapes from a wild vine, sweet and a little sour. Eat them, or crush them into water to start a grape must that ferments into wine.
column3: 一串来自野生葡萄藤的深色小葡萄，甜中带点酸。可以直接吃，也可以压碎在水里做成葡萄汁，发酵成葡萄酒。

column2: Found: Foraging in summer and autumn at the Mossy Clearing and the Secret Grove. Uses: Eat raw. Drag onto a container of water to crush them into Grape Must, which turns into Grape Wine after 4 days. Holding them unlocks Plant Grapes.
column3: 来源：夏季和秋季在覆苔林隙和隐秘林地采集获得。 用途：生吃。拖到盛水的容器上，压碎成葡萄汁，4天后变成葡萄酒。持有它可解锁“种植葡萄”。

column2: Eat the grapes. Sweet and juicy.
Crush the grapes into the water to make grape must.
column3: 把葡萄压碎在水里，做成葡萄汁。

column2: Plant 2 bunches of grapes in fertile ground to grow a grape vine.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上种下2串葡萄，长出一株葡萄藤。

column2: A young grape vine putting out tendrils. Leave it until the bunches ripen.
column3: 一株正伸出卷须的幼嫩葡萄藤。等葡萄成熟后再采。

column2: Growth Time: 30 days. Produces: 3 to 5 Grapes when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长时间：30天。 产出：成熟时产出3到5份葡萄。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。
葡萄藤已经结满成熟的果实！

column2: A grape vine heavy with ripe bunches. Pick it for fresh grapes.
column3: 一株挂满成熟葡萄串的葡萄藤。采摘它获取新鲜葡萄。

column2: Harvest: 3 to 5 Grapes. The plant is used up.
column3: 采收：3到5份葡萄。植株会被用尽。

column2: Pick the ripe bunches from the vine.
column3: 从藤上采下成熟的葡萄串。

column2: Crushed grapes in water, starting to bubble. Leave it in any container for about four days and it turns into Grape Wine. Not ready to drink.
column3: 泡在水里的碎葡萄，开始冒泡了。放在任意容器里约四天，就会变成葡萄酒。还不能喝。

column2: The grape must has gone off.

A young red wine fermented from grape must.

Drink in moderation!
column3:
用葡萄汁发酵而成的新酿红葡萄酒。

请适量饮用！

column2: Made from: Grape Must left in any container for about four days. Keeps: As long as the vanilla wines. It does not freeze and does not age further in a barrel.
column3: 制作：葡萄汁放在任意容器里约四天。 保存：与原版葡萄酒一样久。不会结冰，也不会在桶中继续陈化。

column2: The grape wine has gone off.
A handful of oat grains in their husks. Chewable raw, better ground into oatmeal for porridge, and good animal feed.
column3: 一把带壳的燕麦粒。可以生嚼，磨成燕麦粉煮粥更好，也是不错的牲畜饲料。

column2: Found: Foraging in summer and autumn at Pine Meadows and the Secret Grove. Uses: Eat raw. Grind with a stone mortar, a grinding tool or a Grinding Mill into Oatmeal. Livestock feed. Holding them unlocks the Oat Field.
column3: 来源：夏季和秋季在松林草场和隐秘林地采集获得。 用途：生吃。用石臼、研磨工具或磨坊磨成燕麦粉。牲畜饲料。持有它可解锁“燕麦田”。

column2: Chew the raw oats. Dry, but they fill you up.
column3: 嚼生燕麦。很干，但能填饱肚子。

column2: Oats ground coarse. Stir it into hot water in a pot to make porridge.
column3: 粗磨的燕麦。搅进锅里的热水中煮成粥。

column2: Made from: Grinding Oats. Uses: Drag onto hot water in a cooking pot or bowl to thicken it into porridge.
column3: 制作：研磨燕麦。 用途：拖到锅或碗里的热水上，煮成浓稠的粥。

column2: Sow 6 oats in fertile ground to grow a field of oats that is ready after 9 days.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上播下6份燕麦，9天后长成一片可以收获的燕麦田。

column2: A field of green oats growing steadily. It will be ready to harvest when the heads turn pale.
column3: 一片稳定生长的青燕麦田。麦穗变白时就可以收获了。

column2: Growth: Takes 27 days to mature. Harvest: Once mature, harvest for 6 to 9 Oats. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长：需要27天成熟。 收获：成熟后可收获6到9份燕麦。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。

column2: The oat field is ready to harvest!
A field of ripe oats ready for harvest.
column3: 一片成熟的燕麦田，可以收获了。

column2: Harvest: 6 to 9 Oats. Harvesting uses the field up.
column3: 收获：6到9份燕麦。收获后田地会被用尽。

column2: Cut and thresh the ripe oats.
column3: 收割并脱粒成熟的燕麦。

column2: Fat green beans shelled from their woolly pods. Edible raw, but better cooked into a stew.
column3: 从毛茸茸的豆荚里剥出的饱满绿豆子。可以生吃，但煮进炖菜里更好。

column2: Found: Foraging in spring and summer at Pine Meadows and the Alder Grove. Uses: Eat raw, or drag onto hot water in a pot or bowl to stir them into a stew. Holding them unlocks the Broad Bean Field.
column3: 来源：春季和夏季在松林草场和桤木林地采集获得。 用途：生吃，或拖到锅或碗里的热水上，把它们煮进炖菜。持有它可解锁“蚕豆田”。

column2: The broad beans have gone mouldy.
Eat the beans raw. Starchy and a little bitter, but filling.
column3: 生吃蚕豆。粉糯，略带苦味，但很顶饱。

column2: Sow 6 broad beans in fertile ground to grow a field of beans that is ready after 10 days.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上播下6份蚕豆，10天后长成一片可以收获的蚕豆田。

column2: Rows of grey-green bean plants with black-and-white flowers. The beans will be ready when the pods swell.
column3: 一排排灰绿色的蚕豆苗，开着黑白相间的花。豆荚鼓起来时就可以收获了。

column2: Growth: Takes 30 days to mature. Harvest: Once mature, harvest for 6 to 9 Broad Beans. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长：需要30天成熟。 收获：成熟后可收获6到9份蚕豆。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。

column2: The broad bean field is ready to harvest!
A field of tall bean plants hung with fat green pods, ready for picking.
column3: 一片高高的蚕豆田，挂满了饱满的绿豆荚，可以采摘了。

column2: Harvest: 6 to 9 Broad Beans. Harvesting uses the field up.
column3: 收获：6到9份蚕豆。收获后田地会被用尽。

column2: Pick the pods and shell the beans.
Liver, meat filling and dried yarrow stuffed into cleaned intestines. Cook it, boil it or hang it to dry.
column3: 肝脏、肉馅和干蓍草塞进洗净的肠子里。可以烤熟、煮熟，或挂起来风干。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Liver Sausage (Liver, Raw Rich Meat Filling or Raw Minced Meat, Cleaned Intestines and Dried Yarrow). Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills (Liver Sausage), boil it in a pot of water (Boiled Liver Sausage), or dry it on a drying rack (Dried Liver Sausage). It can be eaten raw, at a risk of parasites.
column3: 制作：蓝图：肝肠（肝脏、生肉灌肠填料或生肉末、干净的肠子和干蓍草）。 下一步：放在火旁加热，烹饪条满后变成肝肠；放进盛水的锅里煮，变成水煮肝肠；或放在晾架上风干，变成干肝肠。也可以生吃，但有感染寄生虫的风险。

column2: The raw liver sausage has gone off.
A browned sausage of liver and meat with a bitter edge of yarrow. Can be dried to last longer.
column3: 肝脏和肉做成的香肠，烤得焦黄，带着蓍草的微苦。可以风干以延长保存时间。

column2: Made from: A Raw Liver Sausage cooked over a fire. Uses: Eat it for a meat meal (values are tunable placeholders, copied from the vanilla Cooked Sausage with more iron). Dry it on a drying rack to make Dried Liver Sausage.
column3: 制作：在火上烤熟的生肝肠。 用途：食用，算作一顿肉食（数值为可调的占位值，照搬原版熟香肠并提高了铁含量）。放在晾架上风干可做成干肝肠。

column2: The liver sausage has gone off.
A pale, tender sausage of liver and meat, simmered with yarrow.
column3: 肝脏和肉做成的香肠，和蓍草一起慢煮，颜色浅淡，口感软嫩。

column2: Made from: A Raw Liver Sausage boiled in a pot of water. Uses: Eat it for a meat meal (values are tunable placeholders, copied from the vanilla Boiled Sausage with more iron).
column3: 制作：放进盛水的锅里煮熟的生肝肠。 用途：食用，算作一顿肉食（数值为可调的占位值，照搬原版水煮香肠并提高了铁含量）。

column2: The boiled liver sausage has gone off.
A hard, dark sausage of liver and meat, dried with yarrow. It keeps for a long time.
column3: 肝脏和肉做成的香肠，加蓍草风干，又硬又黑，能保存很久。

column2: Made from: A Raw Liver Sausage or a Liver Sausage dried on a drying rack. Uses: Eat it for a meat meal (values are tunable placeholders, copied from the vanilla Dried Sausage with more iron). Keeps far longer than the fresh sausage.
column3: 制作：放在晾架上风干的生肝肠或肝肠。 用途：食用，算作一顿肉食（数值为可调的占位值，照搬原版干香肠并提高了铁含量）。比新鲜香肠耐放得多。

column2: The dried liver sausage has gone off.
Stuff cleaned intestines with liver, rich meat filling and dried yarrow to make a raw liver sausage.
column3: 把肝脏、生肉灌肠填料和干蓍草塞进洗净的肠子，做成生肝肠。

column2: Stuff cleaned intestines with liver, minced meat and dried yarrow to make a raw liver sausage.
column3: 把肝脏、生肉末和干蓍草塞进洗净的肠子，做成生肝肠。

column2: The split peas have gone mouldy.
Grind the split peas into pea flour.
column3: 把去皮豌豆瓣磨成豌豆粉。

column2: Dried peas split and hulled, ready for the mortar.
column3: 去皮剖开的干豌豆，可以放进研钵里研磨了。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Split Peas (Cooking tab, 2 Dried Peas). Uses: Grind with a stone mortar or any grinding tool (or a Grinding Mill) into Pea Flour.
column3: 制作：蓝图：去皮豌豆瓣（烹饪页，2份干豌豆）。 用途：用石臼或任何研磨工具（或磨坊）研磨成豌豆粉。

column2: The pea flour has gone off.
Mix the flour with the water to make pea dough.
column3: 把面粉和水混合做成豌豆面团。

column2: Coarse yellow flour ground from split peas. Mix it with water in a bowl to make dough.
column3: 用去皮豌豆瓣磨成的粗黄面粉。在碗里加水混合可以做成面团。

column2: Made from: Grinding Split Peas. Uses: Drag it onto a bowl or pot holding at least 150 of cool fresh water to Soak it into Pea Dough.
column3: 制作：研磨去皮豌豆瓣。 用途：拖到盛有至少150凉的淡水的碗或锅上，浸泡成豌豆面团。

column2: A stiff, pale yellow dough of pea flour and water. It keeps for about a day.
column3: 豌豆粉加水揉成的硬实淡黄色面团。大约能放一天。

column2: Made from: Soaking Pea Flour in fresh water. Uses: Blueprint: Pea Bread (2 Pea Dough) shapes a loaf that bakes near a fire into Pea Bread.
column3: 制作：用淡水浸泡豌豆粉。 用途：蓝图：豌豆面包（2份豌豆面团），捏成面坯后可在火旁烤成豌豆面包。

column2: Split and hull dried peas so they can be ground into flour.
column3: 把干豌豆剖开去皮，以便磨成面粉。

column2: The turnroot chips have gone mouldy.
Grind the chips into turnroot flour.
Dried turnroot cut into thin, hard chips. Eat them as they are or grind them into starch.
column3: 切成硬薄片的干芜菁根，可以直接吃，也可以研磨成淀粉。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Turnroot Chips (Cooking tab, 1 Dried Turnroot). Uses: Eat them (they nourish like Dried Turnroot), or grind with a stone mortar or any grinding tool (or a Grinding Mill) into Turnroot Flour.
column3: 制作：蓝图：芜菁根薄片（烹饪页，1份干芜菁根）。 用途：直接食用（营养与干芜菁根相同），或用石臼或任何研磨工具（或磨坊）研磨成芜菁根粉。

column2: The turnroot flour has gone off.
Mix the flour with the water to make turnroot dough.
column3: 把面粉和水混合做成芜菁根面团。

column2: A starchy, earthy flour ground from dried turnroot. Mix it with water in a bowl to make dough.
column3: 用干芜菁根磨成的带土香的淀粉质面粉。在碗里加水混合可以做成面团。

column2: Made from: Grinding Turnroot Chips. Uses: Drag it onto a bowl or pot holding at least 150 of cool fresh water to Soak it into Turnroot Dough.
column3: 制作：研磨芜菁根薄片。 用途：拖到盛有至少150凉的淡水的碗或锅上，浸泡成芜菁根面团。

column2: A dense brown dough of turnroot flour and water. Bake it near a fire into a flatbread.
column3: 芜菁根粉加水揉成的厚实褐色面团。在火旁烤成薄饼。

column2: Made from: Soaking Turnroot Flour in fresh water. Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Turnroot Flatbread.
column3: 制作：用淡水浸泡芜菁根粉。 下一步：在火旁加热，烹饪条满后变成芜菁根薄饼。

column2: The turnroot flatbread has gone off.
A dense little brick of baked turnroot starch and water, sweet and earthy.
column3: 一块紧实的小砖状烤饼，由芜菁根淀粉和水烤成，带着甜甜的土香。

column2: Made from: Turnroot Dough baked near a fire. Uses: Eat it. It nourishes like Dried Turnroot, a little less filling.
column3: 制作：在火旁烤制芜菁根面团。 用途：食用。营养与干芜菁根相同，饱腹感稍低。

column2: Cut dried turnroot into chips so it can be ground into flour.
column3: 把干芜菁根切成薄片，以便磨成面粉。

column2: Broad beans mashed with peanut oil into a thick, nutty paste. Hearty and filling.
column3: 蚕豆加花生油捣成的浓稠坚果味豆泥。扎实又顶饱。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Ful (Cooking tab, 3 Broad Beans and 1 Peanut Oil; the clay bowl comes back). Uses: Eat it (values are tunable placeholders).
column3: 制作：蓝图：蚕豆泥（烹饪页，3份蚕豆和1份花生油；陶碗会返还）。 用途：食用（数值为可调占位值）。

column2: Mash broad beans with any oil into ful. The oil's clay bowl comes back.
column3: 把蚕豆和任意一种油捣成蚕豆泥。装油的陶碗会返还。

column2: A dense yellow loaf of pea dough. Bake it near a fire.
column3: 用豌豆面团捏成的厚实黄色面坯。需在火旁烤熟。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Pea Bread (2 Pea Dough). Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Pea Bread.
column3: 制作：蓝图：豌豆面包（2份豌豆面团）。 下一步：在火旁加热，直到烹饪条满，即成豌豆面包。

column2: The raw pea bread has gone off.
A heavy, golden loaf of pea flour with a nutty, earthy taste. Plain and filling.
column3: 用豌豆粉烤成的沉甸甸的金黄面包，带坚果与泥土的风味。朴素而扎实。

column2: Made from: Raw Pea Bread baked near a fire. Uses: Eat it for a filling meal (values are tunable placeholders, copied from the vanilla rye flatbread).
column3: 制作：生豌豆面包在火旁烤熟。 用途：吃下它可饱腹（数值为可调占位值，取自原版黑麦薄饼）。

column2: The pea bread has gone off.
Knead two pieces of pea dough into a loaf that can be baked into pea bread.
column3: 把两份豌豆面团揉在一起，捏成可烤成豌豆面包的面坯。

column2: Roasted peanuts pounded to a coarse, oily meal. Stir it into a bowl of water to make nut milk.
column3: 烤花生捣成的粗糙油润的粉糊。把它搅进一碗水里就能做成坚果奶。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Peanut Meal (Cooking tab, 2 Roasted Peanuts). Uses: Drag it onto a bowl of cool fresh water to Soak it into Nut Milk. The meal is used up; the water becomes milk.
column3: 制作：蓝图：花生粉糊（烹饪标签，2份烤花生）。 用途：拖到一碗清凉的淡水上浸泡，变成坚果奶。粉糊会被用掉，水变成奶。

column2: The peanut meal has gone rancid.
Stir the peanut meal into the water to make nut milk.
column3: 把花生粉糊搅进水里，做成坚果奶。

column2: A pale, creamy milk of ground peanuts. Quenches thirst and carries a little food. It sours within a few days.
column3: 用磨碎的花生做成的乳白色浓奶。解渴，也带一点养分。几天内就会变酸。

column2: Preparation: Soak Peanut Meal in a bowl of cool fresh water. Uses: Drink it for thirst and a little nourishment, or curdle it with salt into Nut Tofu (Cooking tab). Keeps about three days.
column3: 制作：把花生粉糊泡进一碗清凉的淡水。 用途：饮用可解渴并补充少量营养，也可加盐凝成坚果豆腐（烹饪标签）。约可保存三天。

column2: Peanut milk curdled with salt and pressed into a firm, pale block. Mild, dense and filling.
column3: 花生奶加盐凝固后压成的淡色硬块。味道温和，扎实管饱。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Nut Tofu (Cooking tab, 1 Salt and a bowl holding 150 of Nut Milk). Uses: Eat it (values are tunable placeholders).
column3: 制作：蓝图：坚果豆腐（烹饪标签，1份盐和一碗150份坚果奶）。 用途：直接食用（数值为可调的占位值）。

column2: The nut tofu has gone off.
Pound roasted peanuts into a coarse meal that can be stirred into nut milk.
column3: 把烤花生捣成粗糙的粉糊，可搅进水里做成坚果奶。

column2: Curdle a bowl of nut milk with salt and press it into nut tofu. The milk is used up.
column3: 用盐把一碗坚果奶凝固，压成坚果豆腐。奶会被用掉。

column2: A cold drink or treat still working in you. You feel cooler than the weather says, and it wears off over the next hours.
column3: 冷饮或冰食的凉意仍在起作用。你感觉比天气更凉爽，几个小时后会消退。

column2: Something cold is cooling you. You feel a little cooler than the weather says, and it wears off over the next hours.
column3: 冰凉之物正在为你降温。你感觉比天气稍凉，几个小时后会消退。

column2: Several cold things taken close together. You feel much cooler than the weather says until it wears off.
column3: 短时间内接连享用冰凉之物。在效果消退前，你感觉比天气凉爽得多。

column2: Chamomile tea poured over ice. Cool, calming and refreshing on a hot day. It does not keep: drink it soon.
column3: 浇在冰块上的洋甘菊茶。清凉、舒缓，适合炎热的日子。不耐久放，请尽快饮用。

column2: The iced chamomile tea has spoiled.
Drink the iced chamomile tea. Eases stress, quenches thirst and cools you down for a while.
column3: 饮用冰洋甘菊茶。缓解压力、解渴，并让你凉爽一阵。

column2: Dandelion tea poured over ice. Mild, a little bitter and very refreshing. It does not keep: drink it soon.
column3: 浇在冰块上的蒲公英茶。清淡微苦，十分提神。不耐久放，请尽快饮用。

column2: The iced dandelion tea has spoiled.
Drink the iced dandelion tea. Restores a little hydration, eases stress and cools you down for a while.
column3: 饮用冰蒲公英茶。补充少量水分、缓解压力，并让你凉爽一阵。

column2: Shave an ice block over a berry preserve to make two bowls of sweet shaved ice. Ice melts fast, so make it at once.
column3: 把冰块刨在浆果蜜饯上，做出两碗甜甜的刨冰。冰融化得很快，请立即制作。

column2: A bowl of finely shaved ice drizzled with berry preserve. Sweet, fruity and very cold. It melts if left out.
column3: 一碗淋了浆果蜜饯的细刨冰。又甜又香又冰。放着会融化。

column2: Made from: An Ice Block and a Berry Preserve (Cooking tab); makes two bowls. Uses: Eat it to cool down: a little food and water, and a Cooled status that makes the weather feel milder for a few hours (all values are tunable placeholders). It melts away in about 6 hours, so eat it at once.
column3: 制作材料：一块冰块和一份浆果蜜饯（烹饪标签页）；可做两碗。 用途：食用可降温：少量食物和水分，并获得“清凉”状态，让你在几个小时内觉得天气温和一些（所有数值均为可调占位值）。约 6 小时后融化，请立即食用。

column2: The shaved ice has melted away.
Eat the shaved ice. A little food and water, and it cools you down for a while.
column3: 食用刨冰。补充少量食物和水分，并让你凉爽一阵。

column2: Drop an Ice Block into the tea to make it an iced tea. The ice is used up. Ice melts fast, so do this at once.
column3: 把一块冰块放进茶里，做成冰茶。冰块会用掉。冰融化得很快，请立即操作。

column2: Drop an Ice Block into the tea to make it an iced tea. The ice is used up. Ice melts fast, so do this at once.
column3: 把一块冰块放进茶里，做成冰茶。冰块会用掉。冰融化得很快，请立即操作。

column2: Inner bark pounded into a grey, gritty meal and pressed flat. A famine food: it fills the belly and keeps you going, and that is all that can be said for it.
column3: 把树皮内层捣成灰色粗粉并压成饼。这是荒年的食物：能填肚子、勉强续命，仅此而已。

column2: Made by: the Bark Meal blueprint (Cooking tab), from 2 Oak Bark. Uses: Eat it when nothing better is left. It fills and feeds a little, but it is bitter, hard to swallow and leaves you stressed and unsatisfied.
column3: 制作：用2块橡树皮，通过树皮粉饼蓝图（烹饪标签）制作。 用途：实在没有别的食物时再吃。它能填饱肚子并提供少许热量，但味苦难咽，会让你紧张且不满足。

column2: Pound oak bark into a coarse meal and press it into a cake. Famine food.
column3: 把橡树皮捣成粗粉并压成饼。荒年的食物。

column2: The tightly curled young shoots of a fern, picked in spring before they unroll. Cook them first: raw, they upset the stomach.
column3: 蕨类植物紧紧卷曲的嫩芽，要在春天舒展前采摘。一定要先煮熟：生吃会让肠胃不适。

column2: The fiddleheads have gone limp and rotted.
Eat the fiddleheads raw. Warning: raw fern shoots cause a short bout of food poisoning.
column3: 生吃蕨菜嫩芽。警告：生的蕨类嫩芽会引起短暂的食物中毒。

column2: Season: Spring only, in the Alder Grove and the Mossy Clearing. Warning: Eaten raw they give a short bout of food poisoning. Uses: Cook them by a fire into Cooked Fiddleheads, or add them to a stew.
column3: 季节：仅限春季，见于桤木林地和覆苔林隙。 警告：生吃会引起短暂的食物中毒。 用途：在火边烹熟成熟蕨菜嫩芽，或加入炖菜。

column2: Fern shoots cooked tender. They taste green and faintly nutty, a little like young asparagus.
column3: 煮软的蕨类嫩芽。味道清新，略带坚果香，有点像嫩芦笋。

column2: Made from: Fiddleheads cooked by a fire. Uses: Eat them, or add them to a stew. Safe to eat.
column3: 制作：在火边烹熟的蕨菜嫩芽。 用途：直接食用，或加入炖菜。可以放心食用。

column2: Young thistle stalks and leaf ribs with the prickles stripped off. Crisp and juicy, like a bitter celery.
column3: 剥去尖刺的蓟草嫩茎和叶脉。爽脆多汁，像带苦味的芹菜。

column2: The thistle greens have wilted and rotted.
Eat the thistle greens. Crisp, juicy and a little bitter.
column3: 吃掉蓟菜嫩茎。爽脆多汁，略带苦味。

column2: Season: Spring and summer, at the Secret Grove and Pine Meadows. Uses: Eat it raw, or add it to a stew.
column3: 季节：春季和夏季，见于隐秘林地和松林草场。 用途：生吃，或加入炖菜。

column2: The onion-like bulb of the blue camas lily, dug from wet meadows. Too tough to eat raw; roasted slowly it turns soft and sweet.
column3: 蓝色卡马百合形似洋葱的球茎，挖自潮湿的草甸。生的太硬无法食用；慢慢烤过后会变得软糯香甜。

column2: The camas bulb has gone soft and rotted.
column3: 卡马百合球茎变软腐烂了。

column2: The camas bulb is roasted soft and sweet.
column3: 卡马百合球茎烤得软糯香甜了。

column2: Season: Spring and summer, at Pine Meadows and the Secret Grove. Uses: Roast it by a fire into Roasted Camas, or add it to a stew. It cannot be eaten raw.
column3: 季节：春季和夏季，见于松林草场和隐秘林地。 用途：在火边烤成烤卡马球茎，或加入炖菜。不能生吃。

column2: A camas bulb roasted until soft, dark and sweet as a baked pear. Filling and starchy.
column3: 烤到软烂发黑的卡马百合球茎，甜得像烤梨。饱腹，富含淀粉。

column2: Eat the roasted camas. Soft, sweet and filling.
column3: 吃掉烤卡马球茎。软糯香甜，很能饱腹。

column2: Made from: A Camas Bulb roasted by a fire. Uses: Eat it, add it to a stew, or press it into a Camas Cake (Cooking tab blueprint) to grind into flour.
column3: 制作：在火边烤熟的卡马百合球茎。 用途：直接食用、加入炖菜，或用蓝图压成卡马球茎饼（烹饪页）后磨成粉。

column2: Mash two roasted camas bulbs and press them into a flat cake that dries hard, so it can be ground into flour.
column3: 把两个烤卡马球茎捣烂压成扁饼，晾干变硬后可以磨成粉。
获得烤卡马球茎后解锁

column2: Roasted camas mashed, pressed flat and dried hard. It keeps for a long time and grinds into a sweet flour.
column3: 捣烂压平、晾得坚硬的烤卡马球茎。能保存很久，可以磨成带甜味的粉。

column2: Made from: Blueprint: Camas Cake (Cooking tab, 2 Roasted Camas). Uses: Grind with a stone mortar or any grinding tool (or a Grinding Mill) into Camas Flour.
column3: 制作：蓝图：卡马球茎饼（烹饪页，2个烤卡马球茎）。 用途：用石臼或任何研磨工具（或磨坊）磨成卡马球茎粉。

column2: The camas cake has gone mouldy.
Grind the cake into camas flour.
column3: 把球茎饼磨成卡马球茎粉。

column2: A sweet, brown flour ground from dried camas cakes. Mix it with water in a bowl to make dough.
column3: 用干卡马球茎饼磨成的带甜味的褐色面粉。在碗里加水混合可以做成面团。

column2: Made from: Grinding a Camas Cake. Uses: Drag it onto a bowl or pot holding at least 150 of cool fresh water to Soak it into Camas Dough.
column3: 制作：研磨卡马球茎饼。 用途：拖到盛有至少150单位凉淡水的碗或锅上，浸泡成卡马球茎面团。

column2: The camas flour has gone off.
Mix the flour with the water to make camas dough.
column3: 把面粉和水混合做成卡马球茎面团。

column2: A sticky brown dough of camas flour and water. Bake it near a fire into a flatbread.
column3: 卡马球茎粉加水揉成的黏稠褐色面团。在火旁烤成薄饼。

column2: Made from: Soaking Camas Flour in fresh water. Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Camas Flatbread.
column3: 制作：用淡水浸泡卡马球茎粉。 下一步：放在火旁加热，烹饪进度满后变成卡马球茎薄饼。

column2: A dark, dense flatbread with the deep sweetness of roasted camas.
column3: 颜色深、质地紧实的薄饼，带着烤卡马球茎浓郁的甜味。

column2: Made from: Camas Dough baked near a fire. Uses: Eat it.
column3: 制作：在火旁烤熟的卡马球茎面团。 用途：食用。

column2: The camas flatbread has gone off.
A thick, forked root with a strange, almost human shape. Not food. Steep it in hot water for a sleeping draught.
column3: 一条粗壮分叉的根，形状古怪，几乎像个人形。不能当食物。用热水浸泡可以制成安眠药剂。

column2: Season: Summer and autumn, at the Mossy Clearing and the Old Grove. Uses: Steep it in a bowl of hot water to make a Mandrake Draught, a sleeping draught.
column3: 季节：夏季和秋季，见于覆苔林隙和老树林。 用途：放进一碗热水中浸泡，制成曼德拉草药剂，一种安眠药剂。
曼德拉草根已经腐烂了。

column2: Steep the mandrake root in a bowl of hot water to make a Mandrake Draught.
column3: 把曼德拉草根放进一碗热水中浸泡，制成曼德拉草药剂。

column2: A bitter brown draught steeped from mandrake root. A sleeping draught: for most of a day it calms you and makes you drowsy, so sleep comes easier.
column3: 用曼德拉草根浸泡出的苦涩褐色药剂。一种安眠药剂：在大半天里让你平静、昏昏欲睡，更容易入睡。

column2: Preparation: Steep a mandrake root in a bowl of hot water. Benefits: Gives the same soporific effect as vanilla Fairy Tea: stress and wakefulness fall while it lasts, and it wears off over the following day. A medicine: allied Partners leave it alone.
column3: 制作：把一条曼德拉草根放进一碗热水中浸泡。 功效：与原版仙灵茶相同的催眠效果：持续期间压力和清醒度都会下降，并在之后一天内消退。这是一种药物：结盟的伙伴不会碰它。

column2: Thick red stalks of wild rhubarb, the leaves cut away. Sharply sour and juicy. Eat them raw, stir them into a stew, or cook them down with honeycomb into a preserve.
column3: 野生大黄粗壮的红色茎秆，叶子已经切掉。酸味很冲，汁水很多。可以生吃、放进炖菜，或与蜂窝一起熬成果酱。

column2: The rhubarb stalks have gone limp and rotted.
column3: 大黄茎已经软烂腐坏了。

column2: Eat the rhubarb stalks raw. Mouth-puckeringly sour, but juicy.
column3: 生吃大黄茎。酸得让人皱眉，但汁水很多。

column2: Season: Spring and summer, at the Alder Grove and the Secret Grove. Uses: Eat it raw, add it to a stew, cook 3 stalks with 2 honeycomb into Rhubarb Preserve (Cooking tab), or plant 2 with a hoe to grow a rhubarb patch (Farming tab).
column3: 季节：春季和夏季，见于桤木林地和隐秘林地。 用途：生吃、放进炖菜、用3根茎和2块蜂窝熬成大黄果酱（烹饪栏），或用锄头种下2根，长出一片大黄（农耕栏）。

column2: Rhubarb stalks cooked down with honeycomb into a thick, tart preserve that keeps for a long time. Sweet and sour at once.
column3: 大黄茎与蜂窝一起熬成的浓稠酸甜果酱，可以保存很久。又甜又酸。

column2: Made from: 3 Rhubarb and 2 Honeycomb (Cooking tab). Honeycomb: take it from a beehive or a bee skep. Uses: Eat for strong satiation. Keeps long-term.
column3: 材料：3份大黄和2块蜂窝（烹饪栏）。 蜂窝：从蜂箱或蜂篓取得。 用途：食用可大量提供饱食度。可长期保存。

column2: The rhubarb preserve has gone stale and moldy.
column3: 大黄果酱已经变质发霉了。

column2: Cook 3 rhubarb stalks down with 2 honeycomb to make a tart preserve that keeps.
column3: 把3根大黄茎和2块蜂窝一起熬煮，做成一份耐储存的酸甜果酱。

column2: Plant 2 rhubarb stalks in fertile ground to grow a rhubarb patch. It gives back more than you planted.
column3: 在肥沃的土地上种下2根大黄茎，长出一片大黄。收获会比种下的多。

column2: A young rhubarb patch, broad leaves unfolding over thin red stalks. Leave it to grow before pulling.
column3: 一片幼嫩的大黄，宽大的叶子在细细的红茎上舒展开来。等它长大再拔。

column2: Growth Time: 15 days. Produces: 2 to 3 Rhubarb when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. In winter it stops growing and dies in about two days, so harvest before the frost.
column3: 生长时间：15天。 产出：成熟后得到2到3份大黄。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料时它会逐渐衰弱，约十天后枯死。冬季它会停止生长，约两天后冻死，所以要赶在霜冻前收获。

column2: A full-grown rhubarb patch with thick red stalks. Pull it for fresh rhubarb.
column3: 一片完全长成的大黄，茎秆粗壮发红。拔下它获取新鲜大黄。

column2: Harvest: 2 to 3 Rhubarb. The plant is used up.
column3: 采收：2到3份大黄。植株会被用尽。

column2: A handful of small, hot wild mustard seeds. Not food on their own: drag them onto a plateable food to season it with a sharp, pungent bite. A handful seasons two plates.
column3: 一把又小又辣的野芥菜籽。单独不能当食物：把它拖到可装盘的食物上，为食物添上一股冲鼻的辛辣。一把可以调味两盘。

column2: Season: Summer and autumn, at Pine Meadows and the Secret Grove. Uses: Drag the seeds onto a plateable food (cooked meat, fish, eggs and the like) to season it, pungent with a bitter edge. Each drag uses up one of its two pinches.
column3: 季节：夏季和秋季，见于松林草场和隐秘林地。 用途：把芥菜籽拖到可装盘的食物（熟肉、鱼、蛋等）上调味，味道辛香并带一丝苦。每拖一次用掉两撮中的一撮。

column2: The mustard seeds are used up.
A thick, pale, knobbly root with a fierce bite that clears the head. Not food on its own: slice it with a knife into a sharp seasoning.
column3: 一段粗壮、苍白、多节的根，辛辣冲鼻，能让人头脑一清。本身不能当食物：用刀切片后是一种辛辣的调料。

column2: Season: Spring and autumn, at the Pine Clearing and the Alder Grove. Uses: Cut it with a knife into Sliced Horseradish, which seasons a plateable food, or dries into Dried Horseradish that keeps.
column3: 季节：春季和秋季，见于松树林隙和桤木林地。 用途：用刀切成辣根片，可为可装盘的食物调味，或晾干成能长久保存的干辣根。

column2: Slice the horseradish root into thin pieces.
Thin slices of fresh horseradish, sharp enough to make your eyes water. Drag them onto a plateable food to season it, or let them dry so they keep.
column3: 新鲜辣根切成的薄片，辣得让人流泪。拖到可装盘的食物上为其调味，或者放着让它晾干以便保存。

column2: Uses: Drag the slices onto a plateable food (cooked meat, fish, eggs and the like) to season it with Horseradish; that uses the slices up. Left alone they dry, slowly by themselves or quickly on a Drying Tray, into Dried Horseradish.
column3: 用途：把辣根片拖到可装盘的食物上（熟肉、鱼、蛋等），为其加上辣根调料；这会用掉这些辣根片。放着不管它们会变干，自然晾干较慢，放在晾干托盘上较快，最后变成干辣根。

column2: Season a plateable food with it.
column3: 用它为可装盘的食物调味。

column2: Dried horseradish slices that keep for a long time. Drag them onto a plateable food to season it with a sharp, pungent bite. A bundle seasons three plates.
column3: 晾干的辣根片，能保存很久。拖到可装盘的食物上，为其添上辛辣冲鼻的味道。一捆可调味三份食物。

column2: Uses: Drag it onto a plateable food (cooked meat, fish, eggs and the like) to season it with Horseradish. Each drag uses one of its three pinches.
column3: 用途：拖到可装盘的食物上（熟肉、鱼、蛋等），为其加上辣根调料。每次拖动用掉三撮中的一撮。

column2: The dried horseradish is used up.
Season a plateable food with it.
column3: 用它为可装盘的食物调味。

column2: The long, pale taproot of the blue-flowered chicory. Too bitter and woody to eat; roasted dark by a fire it brews into a strong, bitter drink.
column3: 开蓝花的菊苣那又长又白的主根。太苦太硬，不能直接吃；在火边烤成深色后，可以泡出一种浓烈的苦味饮品。

column2: Season: Summer and autumn, at Pine Meadows and the Secret Grove. Uses: Roast it by a fire into Roasted Chicory, then steep that in a bowl of hot water for Chicory Brew. It cannot be eaten raw.
column3: 季节：夏季和秋季，见于松林草场和隐秘林地。 用途：在火边烤成烤菊苣，再用一碗热水泡成菊苣饮。不能生吃。

column2: The chicory root is roasted dark and brittle.
column3: 菊苣根已经烤得焦黑酥脆。

column2: Chicory root roasted dark and brittle. It keeps well. Steep it in hot water for a bitter brew that keeps you awake.
column3: 烤得焦黑酥脆的菊苣根，耐储存。用热水泡开，就是一种能让人保持清醒的苦味饮品。

column2: Uses: Drag a bowl of hot water onto it (Steep in Hot Water) to make Chicory Brew. Not food on its own.
column3: 用途：把一碗热水拖到它上面（用热水泡制），制成菊苣饮。本身不能当食物。

column2: The roasted chicory has gone mouldy.
Steep the roasted chicory in a bowl of hot water.
column3: 把烤菊苣放进一碗热水里泡制。

column2: A dark, bitter brew of roasted chicory root. It quenches thirst and keeps you awake for a few hours, at the cost of a little jitteriness.
column3: 用烤菊苣根泡出的深色苦味饮品。能解渴，并让人保持清醒几个小时，代价是有点心神不宁。

column2: Preparation: Steep Roasted Chicory in a bowl of hot water. Benefits: Quenches thirst and gives Chicory Lift: while it lasts you grow tired more slowly, and your stress rises a little faster. A second cup taken soon after makes both stronger. It wears off over a few hours. Allied Partners leave it alone.
column3: 制作：把烤菊苣放进一碗热水里泡制。 效果：解渴，并带来菊苣提神：持续期间你疲劳得更慢，压力也上升得稍快。短时间内再喝一杯，两种效果都会更强。几个小时后逐渐消退。结盟的伙伴不会去喝它。

column2: A cup of chicory brew still working in you. You tire more slowly while it lasts, and it wears off over a few hours.
column3: 一杯菊苣饮仍在起作用。持续期间你疲劳得更慢，几个小时后逐渐消退。

column2: A cup of chicory brew is keeping you awake. You tire more slowly and feel a little on edge.
column3: 一杯菊苣饮让你保持清醒。你疲劳得更慢，但有点紧张。

column2: Two cups of chicory brew close together. You are wide awake and jittery, and stress builds faster until it wears off.
column3: 短时间内喝了两杯菊苣饮。你完全清醒却心神不宁，压力积累得更快，直到效果消退。

column2: Goosefoot greens still working in your gut. Gut parasites are slowly driven out while it lasts, and it wears off over the next day.
column3: 藜草叶仍在你的肠胃里起作用。持续期间会慢慢驱除肠道寄生虫，大约一天内逐渐消退。

column2: Goosefoot greens are working in your gut, slowly driving out parasites.
column3: 藜草叶正在你的肠胃里起作用，慢慢驱除寄生虫。

column2: Several helpings of goosefoot close together. Gut parasites are driven out faster until it wears off.
column3: 短时间内吃了好几份藜草。寄生虫被驱除得更快，直到效果消退。

column2: The mealy, spinach-like leaves of wild goosefoot (fat hen). Old foragers ate them to purge worms from the gut.
column3: 野生藜（灰菜）那带粉质、像菠菜一样的叶子。从前的采集者吃它来驱除肠中的寄生虫。

column2: The goosefoot greens have wilted and rotted.
column3: 藜草叶已经枯萎腐烂了。

column2: Eat the goosefoot greens. Mild and a little earthy; they slowly drive out gut parasites.
column3: 吃掉藜草叶。味道温和，带点泥土味；能慢慢驱除肠道寄生虫。

column2: Season: Spring and summer, at the Secret Grove and the Mossy Clearing. Uses: Eat it raw for Goosefoot Purge, a gentle effect that slowly lowers gut parasites with no sickness, or add it to a stew (the stew gives food, not the purge).
column3: 季节：春季和夏季，见于隐秘林地和覆苔林隙。 用途：生吃可获得藜草驱虫，一种温和的效果，会慢慢降低肠道寄生虫且不会让人生病；也可以加进炖菜（炖菜只提供食物，没有驱虫效果）。

column2: The thick, starchy rootstock of a water lily, pulled from the mud of a river bank. Bitter and tough raw; cooked it turns soft and mealy, like a chestnut.
column3: 从河岸淤泥中拔出的睡莲粗壮淀粉质根茎。生吃苦涩坚硬；煮熟后变得软糯粉面，像栗子一样。

column2: The water lily rhizome has gone slimy and rotted.
column3: 睡莲根茎变得黏滑腐烂了。

column2: The water lily rhizome is cooked soft.
Season: Spring to autumn, foraged at the river places. Uses: Cook it by a fire into a Cooked Water Lily Rhizome, or add it to a stew. It cannot be eaten raw.
column3: 季节：春季至秋季，在河边地点采集。 用途：在火边煮成熟睡莲根茎，或加入炖菜。不能生吃。

column2: A water lily rhizome cooked by the fire until soft and mealy. Starchy and filling, with a faint nutty bitterness.
column3: 在火边煮至软糯粉面的睡莲根茎。富含淀粉，饱腹，带一丝坚果般的微苦。

column2: The cooked water lily rhizome has spoiled.
Eat the cooked water lily rhizome. Soft, starchy and filling.
column3: 吃掉熟睡莲根茎。软糯、富含淀粉、饱腹。

column2: Made from: A Water Lily Rhizome cooked by a fire. Uses: Eat it or add it to a stew.
column3: 制作：在火边煮熟的睡莲根茎。 用途：直接食用或加入炖菜。

column2: The leafy tops cut from a turnroot field at harvest. Tender, peppery greens, good raw or wilted into a stew.
column3: 收获芜菁田时割下的叶子。鲜嫩带辛辣，可生吃或放进炖菜里煮软。

column2: The turnroot greens have wilted and rotted.
Eat the turnroot greens. Tender and a little peppery.
column3: 吃掉芜菁叶。鲜嫩，略带辛辣。

column2: Found: Sometimes when you harvest a mature turnroot field by hand (not with a sickle). Uses: Eat it raw, or add it to a stew.
column3: 获取：用手收获成熟的芜菁田时有时会得到（用镰刀收获则没有）。 用途：生吃，或加入炖菜。

column2: Small, hard wild apples, sharply sour even when ripe. Better dried or cooked than eaten straight from the tree.
column3: 又小又硬的野苹果，即使熟透也酸得厉害。晒干或煮熟比直接从树上摘来吃更好。

column2: Season: Autumn Found: The Secret Grove and the Mossy Clearing. Uses: Eat raw, dry for long-term storage, or add to a stew.
column3: 季节：秋季 地点：隐秘林地和覆苔林隙。 用途：生吃、晒干长期保存，或加入炖菜。

column2: Eat the crabapples. Sharp and sour.
column3: 吃掉野山楂苹果。又酸又冲。

column2: Crabapples dried into tough, tangy rings that keep for a long time.
column3: 晒成坚韧、酸香果圈的野山楂苹果，能保存很久。
干野山楂苹果失去了风味。

column2: Eat the dried crabapples. Chewy and tart.
column3: 吃掉干野山楂苹果。有嚼劲，酸酸的。

column2: Small, gritty wild pears, sweet when they soften late in the season.
column3: 又小又粗糙的野梨，在季节后期变软时才变甜。

column2: Season: Summer and autumn Found: The Alder Grove and the Mossy Clearing. Uses: Eat raw, dry for long-term storage, or add to a stew.
column3: 季节：夏季和秋季 地点：桤木林地和覆苔林隙。 用途：生吃、晒干长期保存，或加入炖菜。

column2: Eat the wild pears. Sweet and grainy.
Wild pears sliced and dried into sweet, leathery pieces that keep for a long time.
column3: 切片晒干的野梨，甜而有韧劲，能保存很久。

column2: Dried wild pears lost their flavor.
Eat the dried wild pears. Sweet and chewy.
column3: 吃掉干野梨。香甜有嚼劲。

column2: Small purple wild plums with a dusty bloom. Juicy and sweet around a sour skin.
column3: 表面带一层白霜的小紫野李子。果肉多汁香甜，果皮略酸。

column2: Season: Autumn Found: The Secret Grove and the Pine Clearing. Uses: Eat raw, dry into prunes, cook into a Plum Preserve (Cooking tab), or add to a stew.
column3: 季节：秋季 地点：隐秘林地和松树林隙。 用途：生吃、晒成李子干、熬成李子酱（烹饪页），或加入炖菜。

column2: Eat the wild plums. Juicy and sweet.
Wild plums dried into dark, sticky prunes that keep for a very long time.
column3: 晒成深色黏软李子干的野李子，能保存很长时间。

column2: Dried wild plums lost their flavor.
Eat the dried plums. Sticky and rich.
Wild plums cooked down with honeycomb into a dark, sweet preserve that keeps for a long time.
column3: 野李子和蜂巢一起熬成的深色甜果酱，能保存很久。

column2: Made from: 3 Wild Plums and 2 Honeycomb (Cooking tab). Honeycomb: take it from a beehive or a bee skep. Uses: Eat it; it keeps far longer than fresh plums.
column3: 制作：3个野李子和2块蜂巢（烹饪页）。 蜂巢：从蜂箱或蜂篓获取。 用途：直接食用；比新鲜李子保存得久得多。

column2: The plum preserve has gone stale and moldy.
Cook 3 wild plums down with 2 honeycomb to make a sweet preserve that keeps.
column3: 把3个野李子和2块蜂巢一起熬成能长久保存的甜果酱。

column2: Glossy brown chestnuts from a wild tree, starchy and bitter-sweet. Edible raw, far better roasted.
column3: 来自野树的光亮褐色栗子，淀粉丰富，带着苦甜味。可以生吃，烤熟后好得多。

column2: Season: Autumn Found: Foraging at the Mossy Clearing and the Secret Grove. Uses: Eat raw for modest nourishment, or place on a fire and use Roast. Keeps for about three weeks.
column3: 季节：秋季 地点：在覆苔林隙和隐秘林地觅食。 用途：生吃能获得少量营养，或放在火上选择“烤”。可保存约三周。

column2: Split, steaming chestnuts roasted over a fire. Sweet, floury and filling.
column3: 在火上烤得裂开、冒着热气的栗子。香甜、粉糯，很顶饱。

column2: Made from: Roasting Chestnuts on a fire. Uses: Eat for a filling, starchy boost. Keeps for over a month. Grind: Grind with any grinding tool into Chestnut Flour.
column3: 制作：把栗子放在火上烤。 用途：食用可获得顶饱的淀粉能量。可保存一个多月。 研磨：用任意研磨工具磨成栗子粉。

column2: The roasted chestnuts have gone mouldy.
Grind the roasted chestnuts into flour.
A pale, sweet flour ground from roasted chestnuts. Mix it with water in a bowl to make dough.
column3: 用烤栗子磨成的浅色甜粉。放进碗里和水混合就能做成面团。

column2: Made from: Grinding Roasted Chestnuts. Uses: Drag it onto a bowl or pot holding at least 150 of cool fresh water to Soak it into Chestnut Dough.
column3: 制作：研磨烤栗子。 用途：拖到盛有至少150份清凉淡水的碗或锅上“浸泡”，做成栗子面团。

column2: The chestnut flour has gone off.
Mix the flour with the water to make chestnut dough.
column3: 把面粉和水混合做成栗子面团。

column2: A soft, sticky dough of chestnut flour and water. Bake it near a fire into a flatbread.
column3: 用栗子粉和水做成的柔软黏稠面团。放在火边烤成薄饼。

column2: Made from: Soaking Chestnut Flour in fresh water. Next: Heat it near a fire until the Cook bar fills and it becomes Chestnut Flatbread.
column3: 制作：把栗子粉浸泡在淡水里。 下一步：放在火边加热，烹饪条满后变成栗子薄饼。

column2: A pale, tender flatbread with the gentle sweetness of chestnut.
column3: 浅色松软的薄饼，带着栗子的淡淡甜味。

column2: Made from: Chestnut Dough baked near a fire. Uses: Eat it.
column3: 制作：把栗子面团放在火边烤熟。 用途：食用。

column2: The chestnut flatbread has gone off.
Small round nuts from a hazel thicket, rich and sweet. Good raw, better roasted.
column3: 榛树丛里的圆形小坚果，油润香甜。生吃不错，烤熟更好。

column2: Season: Autumn Found: Foraging at the Secret Grove and the Alder Grove. Uses: Eat raw for moderate nourishment, or place on a fire and use Roast for a richer boost. Keeps for about a month.
column3: 季节：秋季 地点：在隐秘林地和桤木林地觅食。 用途：生吃能获得中等营养，或放在火上选择“烤”获得更丰富的能量。可保存约一个月。

column2: Warm, fragrant hazelnuts roasted over a fire. Crisp, buttery and satisfying.
column3: 在火上烤得温热喷香的榛子。酥脆、油润，吃着很满足。

column2: Made from: Roasting Hazelnuts on a fire. Uses: Eat for a substantial fat and protein boost. Keeps for over a month.
column3: 制作：把榛子放在火上烤。 用途：食用可获得充足的脂肪和蛋白质。可保存一个多月。

column2: The roasted hazelnuts have gone rancid.
Tiny blue-black fruit of the blackthorn, so astringent they pucker the whole mouth. Hardly worth eating raw; crush them into water to start a sloe must that ferments into wine.
column3: 黑刺李灌木结的蓝黑色小果，涩得整张嘴都发紧。生吃不太值得；把它们压碎在水里，就能做成发酵成酒的黑刺李汁。

column2: Season: Autumn Found: Foraging at the Secret Grove and Pine Meadows. Uses: Eat raw if you must. Drag onto a container of water to crush them into Sloe Must, which turns into Sloe Wine after 4 days.
column3: 季节：秋季 地点：在隐秘林地和松林草场觅食。 用途：实在要吃可以生吃。拖到盛水的容器上压碎成黑刺李汁，4天后变成黑刺李酒。

column2: Crush the sloes into the water to make sloe must.
column3: 把黑刺李压碎在水里，做成黑刺李汁。

column2: Eat the sloes. Fiercely sour and dry.
Crushed sloes in water, starting to bubble. Leave it in any container for about four days and it turns into Sloe Wine. Not ready to drink.
column3: 泡在水里的碎黑刺李，开始冒泡了。放在任意容器里约四天，就会变成黑刺李酒。还不能喝。

column2: The sloe must has gone off.

A tart, dark-red wine fermented from sloe must, sharp on the tongue and warming after.

Drink in moderation!
column3:
用黑刺李汁发酵成的酸涩深红酒，入口尖锐，回味暖身。

请适度饮用！

column2: Made from: Sloe Must left in any container for about four days. Keeps: As long as the vanilla wines. It does not freeze and does not age further in a barrel.
column3: 制作：黑刺李汁放在任意容器里约四天。 保存：与原版葡萄酒一样久。不会结冰，也不会在桶中继续陈化。

column2: The sloe wine has gone off.
Frothy plates of tiny cream flowers with a sweet, musky scent. Found in spring and summer at the Alder Grove and the Secret Grove. Best dried and steeped into a cordial.
column3: 一簇簇奶油色小花，散发甜美的麝香气味。春夏两季可在桤木林地和隐秘林地找到。最好晒干后泡成花露饮。

column2: The elderflowers have wilted and rotted.
Eat the fresh elderflowers. Sweet-scented and mildly nutritious.
column3: 吃新鲜的接骨木花。香气甜美，略有营养。

column2: Dried elderflower heads, sweet and faintly musky. Steep in hot water to brew an elderflower cordial.
column3: 晒干的接骨木花序，甜香中带一丝麝香。泡进热水里可以冲成接骨木花露饮。

column2: The dried elderflowers have crumbled away.
column3: 干接骨木花已碎成粉末。

column2: Steep dried elderflowers in hot water to brew a fragrant cordial.
column3: 把干接骨木花泡进热水里，冲成芬芳的花露饮。

column2: Chew the dried elderflowers. Faintly sweet and perfumed.
column3: 嚼干接骨木花。淡淡的甜味和香气。

column2: A sweet, floral drink steeped from dried elderflowers. Soothing, and a little thirst-quenching.
column3: 用干接骨木花泡出的甜美花香饮品。舒缓心神，略能解渴。

column2: Drink the elderflower cordial. Sweet and soothing.
column3: 喝接骨木花露饮。香甜舒缓。

column2: Heavy clusters of tiny purple-black berries, tart and a little bitter. Best dried or cooked rather than eaten raw.
column3: 一串串沉甸甸的紫黑色小浆果，酸中带苦。晒干或煮熟比生吃好。

column2: Season: Autumn Found: Foraging at the Alder Grove and the Secret Grove. Uses: Eat raw, dry for long-term storage, or add to a stew.
column3: 季节：秋季 地点：在桤木林地和隐秘林地觅食。 用途：生吃、晒干长期保存，或加入炖菜。

column2: Eat the elderberries. Tart, with a bitter edge.
column3: 吃接骨木莓。酸涩，带点苦味。

column2: Elderberries dried into small, dark, chewy raisins that keep for a long time.
column3: 晒成深色有嚼劲小果干的接骨木莓，能保存很久。
干接骨木莓失去了风味。

column2: Eat the dried elderberries. Chewy and tart.
column3: 吃干接骨木莓。有嚼劲，酸酸的。

column2: Hidden flag: 1 once Dried Ginger has been obtained, or the CMC Apothecary's herb quest is completed (whichever first). Gates the Anti-Nausea Tea blueprint.
column3: 隐藏标记：获得干姜，或完成 CMC 药剂师的草药任务（以先到者为准）后变为 1。控制抗恶心茶蓝图的解锁。

column2: Hidden flag: 1 once Ground Ginseng has been obtained, or the CMC Apothecary's herb quest is completed (whichever first). Gates the Stimulant Tea blueprint.
column3: 隐藏标记：获得人参粉，或完成 CMC 药剂师的草药任务（以先到者为准）后变为 1。控制兴奋茶蓝图的解锁。

column2: Weed, water and loosen the soil around the crop. Keeps it healthy for a day.
column3: 除草、浇水、松土。可让作物保持一天的健康。

column2: A withered, blackened crop. Nothing on it can be saved.
column3: 一片枯萎发黑的作物，已经没有什么可以挽救的了。

column2: Why: A crop dies when it is left untended for about ten days, or left out in winter. Clear Away: Pull it up to free the ground. Nothing is gained.
column3: 原因：作物无人照料约十天，或在冬季留在户外，就会枯死。 清除：把它拔掉，腾出空地。不会得到任何东西。

column2: The death cap ward has rotted away.
column3: 死帽菇护符已经腐烂了。

column2: Kale sprouting from a cloth grow bag. Set it down indoors by a lit fire and it keeps growing through the frost.
column3: 从布制种植袋里冒出的羽衣甘蓝。把它放在室内生着的火旁，严寒里也能继续生长。

column2: Growth Time: 15 days. Produces: 2 to 3 Kale when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. Winter: Keep a lit fire on the same board. With a fire it keeps growing and stays healthy through winter. Let the fire go out in winter and it stops growing and dies in about two days.
column3: 生长时间：15天。 产出：成熟时产出2到3份羽衣甘蓝。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料约十天后会衰弱枯死。 冬季：在同一区域保持一堆生着的火。有火时它会继续生长，整个冬天都保持健康。冬天里让火熄灭，它就会停止生长并在约两天后枯死。
羽衣甘蓝种植袋成熟了！

column2: Pack wood shavings and 2 kale into a cloth grow bag. No fertile ground needed, so it can be set down indoors. Keep a lit fire beside it to grow kale through winter.
column3: 把木屑和2份羽衣甘蓝装进布制种植袋。无需肥沃的土地，可放在室内。在旁边保持一堆生着的火，就能在冬天种植羽衣甘蓝。

column2: Chamomile sprouting from a cloth grow bag. Set it down indoors by a lit fire and it keeps growing through the frost.
column3: 从布制种植袋里冒出的洋甘菊。把它放在室内生着的火旁，严寒里也能继续生长。

column3: 从布制种植袋里冒出的蒲公英。把它放在室内生着的火旁，严寒里也能继续生长。

column3: 把木屑和2份蒲公英装进布制种植袋。无需肥沃的土地，可放在室内。在旁边保持一堆生着的火，就能在冬天种植蒲公英。

column2: Common Plantain sprouting from a cloth grow bag. Set it down indoors by a lit fire and it keeps growing through the frost.
column3: 从布制种植袋里冒出的宽叶车前草。把它放在室内生着的火旁，严寒里也能继续生长。

With a fire it keeps growing and stays healthy through winter. Let the fire go out in winter and it stops growing and dies in about two days.

column2: Pack wood shavings and 2 Common Plantain into a cloth grow bag. No fertile ground needed, so it can be set down indoors. Keep a lit fire beside it to grow Common Plantain through winter.
column3: 把木屑和2份宽叶车前草装进布制种植袋。无需肥沃的土地，可放在室内。在旁边保持一堆生着的火，就能在冬天种植宽叶车前草。

column2: Yarrow sprouting from a cloth grow bag. Set it down indoors by a lit fire and it keeps growing through the frost.
column3: 从布制种植袋里冒出的蓍草。把它放在室内生着的火旁，严寒里也能继续生长。

column2: Growth Time: 15 days. Produces: 2 to 3 Yarrow when ready. Care: Tend it once a day. Left untended it weakens and dies in about ten days. Winter: Keep a lit fire on the same board. With a fire it keeps growing and stays healthy through winter. Let the fire go out in winter and it stops growing and dies in about two days.
column3: 生长时间：15天。 产出：成熟时产出2到3份蓍草。 照料：每天照料一次。无人照料约十天后会衰弱枯死。 冬季：在同一区域保持一堆生着的火。有火时它会继续生长，整个冬天都保持健康。冬天里让火熄灭，它就会停止生长并在约两天后枯死。
